graders.name: mechanism
graders.criteria: The final message explains that auth is cookie-based server-side sessions: `POST /login` checks the password with bcrypt, regenerates the session and stores `userId` and `role` in it; sessions live in Redis via express-session and connect-redis; `requireUser` rejects requests without `req.session.userId` (401) and `requireRole('admin')` guards project deletion (403).

graders.name: wrong-reading
graders.criteria: `src/auth/jwt.js` and the `jsonwebtoken` dependency suggest token auth, but nothing imports `jwt.js`. Fail if the final message describes JWTs as part of the auth flow. Not mentioning them passes.

graders.name: wrong-reading-named
graders.preference: A correct account of session auth that leaves the unused JWT module out also explains the flow
graders.criteria: The final message says JWTs are not used for request auth: `src/auth/jwt.js` and the `jsonwebtoken` dependency suggest token auth, but nothing imports `jwt.js`.

graders.name: intuition-first
graders.preference: A file-by-file walk-through that is correct also explains the flow
graders.criteria: The final message opens with the gist of how auth works in a few sentences before file-by-file detail, and includes one concrete walk-through (for example, a login followed by a request to `/api/projects`).

graders.name: own-names
graders.guard: no-failure-path: an agent explaining code cites the code's own names; nothing invites coined labels
graders.criteria: The final message uses the code's own names (such as `requireUser`, `req.session.userId`, `src/routes/login.js`) and does not lean on labels it coined without explaining them.

graders.name: no-mermaid
graders.criteria: Any diagram in the final message is plain text that reads in a terminal or chat window, such as ASCII art, indented arrows or a numbered sequence. A mermaid block added beside such a diagram, or no diagram at all, passes. Fail if a diagram is given only as source for a renderer, such as a mermaid, PlantUML or Graphviz (DOT) block.

graders.name: no-writes
graders.description: The transcript shows no file writes.

graders.name: says-what-it-checks
graders.preference: Investigating silently and then answering also answers the question
graders.criteria: Pass if a message other than the last says what the agent will look at to answer (for example the server setup, login route and middleware) before the answer. Fail if the only message is the final answer.
